---
title: AI Policy
---

AI tools are welcome, but you are responsible for what you submit: review it, test it, and be ready to discuss it.

We discourage drive-by AI contributions from people who don't use DAS or work in fiber-optic sensing. If you are new to the field and want to help, start with an existing issue or a [discussion](https://github.com/DASDAE/dascore/discussions).
